question: Who dwells in the world of Mahat?
premises: Seers, sages, and perfected beings such as Markandeya abide there.
Gods whose offices have been completed also dwell there.
Both groups are situated in the world of Mahat.
inference: Mahat is inhabited by accomplished beings and by gods who have finished their cosmic duties.
plain_english: In Mahat dwell seers, sages, and perfected beings such as Markandeya, and also gods whose offices have come to an end.
